children.value: > Fact From Story: That’s ultimately what happened with FTX, as financial discrepancies racked up between the exchange and its sister company Alameda Research (a trader itself on the platform).
> > Fact From Story: The failure is indisputable: The jury will now have to decide how criminal, and how far, his intentions were around that.
> > > Fact From Story: Alameda was also getting loans from outside lenders, such as Genesis, because when FTX started, there weren’t a lot of customer funds to borrow, Ellison testified.
> > > Fact From Story: FTX was keeping cozy private ties with Alameda yet publicly holding it at arm’s length.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge: A company can have financial discrepancies if it is keeping private ties.
> > Commonsense Knowledge: Financial discrepancies are a failure of management.
> Commonsense Knowledge: Financial discrepancies can cause a company to fail.
